faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bastar District Masseurs recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Bastar District Masseurs posts is 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Masseurs posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for all the Masseurs posts is 8th Pass. Specific physical fitness criteria are also mentioned for the Massager posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for these positions is between 18 years and 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Masseurs posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Masseurs posts will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 10856.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Masseurs posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Masseurs posts in Bastar District. This includes 1 for Masseurs Male, 1 for Masseurs Female

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Bastar District Masseurs recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Masseurs posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a Merit List prepared from the marks obtained in the qualifying examination.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for contractual positions. Selected candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Bastar District. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
